# PartsNow — Ask Mike (AI truck parts assistant)

> Mike is the free AI specialist at PartsNow.ai for heavy-duty truck and trailer parts. He helps owner-operators, mechanics, and fleets diagnose problems and find the right part — by chat, phone, or text, in English or Spanish, 24/7. Based in Knoxville, TN; ships nationwide across the United States. No account required, and the help is free whether you buy or not.

## Contact
- Chat with Mike: https://agent.partsnow.ai
- Call or text (English): (865) 290-5485
- Call or text (Spanish / Español): (865) 217-5813
- Full catalog & checkout: https://partsnow.ai

## What Mike does
- Diagnoses truck symptoms from plain descriptions — no part number or technical terms needed
- Identifies parts from a photo or a VIN
- Recommends the right part plus a budget alternative when it makes sense
- Orders from PartsNow.ai (new or OEM) with nationwide shipping or free pickup in Knoxville, TN
- Answers in the same language you write or speak (English or Spanish)

## Coverage
- Heavy-duty trucks & trailers: Freightliner, Peterbilt, Kenworth, Mack, Volvo, International
- Categories: brakes & wheel end, air system, electrical & lighting, engine, filtration, trailer parts, driveline, hydraulics
- 16,000+ new and OEM parts with OEM cross-references from trusted dealers

## US Truck Encyclopedia
Specs, engines, years, GVWR ratings and history for 209+ US commercial truck models (Class 3–8) across 25 makes — each model has its own page with common replacement parts and Mike available for diagnosis.
